messages:
Dana R: Quick usability report from mobile QA. On narrow phones the filter bar becomes sticky and overlaps the first table row when the on-screen keyboard appears. Repro: open Runs, tap filter input, keyboard pops, first row gets pushed under the bar. Screenshot: https://redwood-screenshots/runs-filter-keyboard.jpg :iphone:

Hector M: Oof. We're setting the filter bar to position: sticky; top: 56px, but iOS/Android keyboards change viewport height so it doesn't recalc. Could we switch to position: fixed when input is focused and compute offset from window.visualViewport?

Lina V: That would help. Also saw that expanding a row accordion (to show details) collapses when you scroll the table while the nav is open. The accordion's scroll anchor is lost. We should preserve expanded state and restore scroll position.

Dana R: UX suggestion: make accordion a slide-over panel on narrow widths instead of expanding inline. Keeps rows consistent and avoids height thrash. The panel can be dismissible with swipe-down.

Hector M: Slide-over is doable but we must ensure focus is trapped and a11y announcements are made. Also slide-over must respect prefers-reduced-motion. Pseudo: ```js
if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) openPanelInstant(); else openPanelAnimated();
```

Lina V: For keyboard bug, we can listen to visualViewport resize and set nav/filter top properly:```js
visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', () => { const offset = visualViewport.offsetTop; filterBar.style.top = `${offset}px`; });
```

Dana R: Good. Copy nit while we're at it: the action button inside the accordion currently says "Open" which is ambiguous. Propose "View details" on mobile and keep "Open" on desktop.

ux-ci-bot: Automated checks: visual-regression reg-2026-03-23-21 flagged header overlap at 612px. Keyboard-nav test failed when slide-over traps focus incorrectly (tabbing cycles within but doesn't return focus on close).

Hector M: I'll add a focus-restoration util: save activeElement before opening, then on close call saved.focus() inside requestAnimationFrame. Also ensure aria-hidden toggles for background content.

Lina V: Another small thing: the swipe zone for nav close is too wide and conflicts with horizontal table swipes for action menus. Recommend a 24px deadzone from the content edge. If swipe starts inside deadzone ignore closing.

Dana R: Can we also change the ellipsis behavior in table cells? Long tokens (e.g., model IDs) are being truncated but users need copy-to-clipboard. Suggest adding a small copy icon that exposes on swipe-left per row on mobile.

Hector M: We'll prototype a reveal action: swipe-left reveals actions (Copy, Share). Make sure swipe velocity threshold is moderate. Also add a tooltip fallback for long-press to copy when action reveal isn't used.

qa-bot: Regression: copy-to-clipboard action failing in Safari because Clipboard API requires user gesture inside the panel. Workaround: use execCommand fallback for now.

mobile-preview-bot: Preview deployed: https://preview.redwood/ux/accordion-filter-fixes (build 2026.03.23-1620)

Dana R: Action items: Hector to implement visualViewport offsets + focus restore, Lina to mock slide-over pattern + copy text, QA to re-run on iOS Safari and Android Chrome. We'll review in tomorrow's mobile sync. Thanks! :thumbsup:
